title: Surface area of disjoint intervals
statement: Let $m\ge 0$, and let $a,b:\{1,\ldots,m\}\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $a_j<b_j$ for every $j$. Suppose the closed intervals $[a_i,b_i]$ are pairwise disjoint. The Gaussian surface area in $\mathbb R$ of their union is $\sum_{j=1}^m\bigl(\varphi(a_j)+\varphi(b_j)\bigr)$, where $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density.
hypotheses_covered: The closed intervals are pairwise disjoint
